posts.title: It feels like the end of the world
Chrome Heaven Portal Upgrade
posts.content:
Welcome to the new Chrome Heaven blog and official portal!

I have redesigned the layout to act as a direct blog and official page. I am transitioning away from external platforms like SoundCloud to host my own music and content.

Now, all music tracks and photography edits will be served directly from this page. You can listen to my new tracks in the Windows Media Player window and view high-quality renders in the Visuals folder. More updates coming soon.
